findings.fact: The stated test correctly establishes whether D9 and D7 are winners.
findings.explanation: Authorized history shows each defender has played two diamonds, including DA and DT, and North now holds DQ97 on lead. DQ is the highest remaining diamond. If both defenders follow, all six original defensive diamonds have been played, establishing D9 and D7. With four declarer tricks already won, these three diamonds plus South's HA and CK complete nine; North retains H4 and C4 for access to South.
